newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil - high sulphur up, low sulphur down.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil - high sulphur up, low sulphur down.

text.p: Fuel oil faced mixed fortunes in the north with deals pushing up high sulphur prices and depressing low sulphur levels.

High sulphur barges cautiously crept higher after being knocked lower yesterday and prices climbed back and a touch over Thursday's closing levels. Dealers said an unconfirmed $125 fob ARA was the high amid several con
Activity was sporadic with all eyes on Brent, gas oil and bunker demand. On Friday shippers were looking for about 10,000-12,000 tonnes.

A deal heard done at $117 fob NWE was initially met with some scepticism, with some traders citing cheaper Russian straight run, a M-100 30kt 2.5 percent sulphur, maximum 0.5 water was sold at $120.50 cif ARA.
Gradually the market began to accept the fresh level, up $1.5 on a deal yesterday.

The low sulphur market ended a busy week with another deal. The main Med buyer picking up its fourth cargo of the week. The price was 50:50 fixed/formula at $132 cif Italy, compared with the $135 cif the buyer had secured product for earlier in the week.
